messages:
Anika: Quick sync — we need to lock the design‑partner commitment criteria and feedback bandwidth for the March pilot. How many active partners can we realistically support, and what are the hard launch gates? :thinking_face:
Jared: We're capacity‑limited by eng review time and onboarding hours. Rough calc: 8 active DP concurrently with 2 eng leads + 1 biz‑ops. Burst to 12 for 2 weeks if we pause new signups. No SLA for burst.
Priya: Agree with 8 steady. Ops note: onboarding checklist takes ~4 hours per partner (tech + legal + billing). If we want faster, we need a concierge rotation.
Ken: From infra/serving side — if partners run heavy evals (long contexts) their KV cache usage will spike. Recommend capping long‑context jobs or routing to Dedicated variants.
Chloe: Incentives: $500 infra credit + prioritized support and roadmap input usually works. For enterprise prospects, offer Private preview w/ NDA.
Anika: Metrics to define success? My proposal: (1) activation < 14 days, (2) weekly active calls >= 3, (3) integration smoke tests pass, (4) zero severity‑1 regressions, (5) qualitative NPS >= 7. Thoughts?
Jared: Add token spend target (to measure real usage) and a prompt‑quality regression threshold (we should define acceptable perplexity/score drop).
Priya: Also retention at 30 days and # of unique users per partner. Ops needs clear SLA for support response times for DP vs public beta.
Ken: Launch gates I care about: model rollout safety checks completed, fallback routing in place, and cache eviction policy tested.
Anika: OK — gating checklist draft: integration smoke, perf baselines, fallback, legal signed, incentive ack, eval set + regression test.
Chloe: Recruitment profile: mix of 4 integrations (UI SDK), 2 infra heavy (batch/embeddings), 2 enterprise (private data). That gives diverse signals.
Jared: Recruitment throughput: we should target inviting 20 candidates to get ~8 committed (40% conversion). Use a lightweight screener.
Anika: Can someone drop a concise invite + screener text? Prefer one that asks for clear signal of integration readiness and primary success metric.
Jared: Draft invite snippet:
invite_snippet:
Jared: Hi — we'd love you in Redwood's March pilot. Quick screener (1‑2 min): 1) primary use case, 2) expected monthly token volume, 3) integration timeline (weeks), 4) do you need private deployment/NDA? Reply or fill: https://tiny.redwood/pilot‑form :rocket:

Please confirm if you'd like credits + prioritized support.
messages_continued:
Priya: Recommend adding a checkbox for compliance/regulatory workloads so we can route to Private early.
Ken: Also add a field for 'typical sequence length' so runtime can pick model variants.
Chloe: For feedback cadence — weekly async survey + one 30‑min sync every 2 weeks. We should store prompts + outputs for regression tests (with partner consent).
Anika: Consent template: we only store examples for eval and will anonymize; partners can opt out of storing PII.
ops-bot: Meeting created: DP invite rhythms — Fri 11am PT — calendar invite sent.
Jared: Action items: (1) Jared to finalize invite + screener by Tue EOD, (2) Priya to scope concierge hours & ops runbook, (3) Ken to write perf gating checklist, (4) Chloe to draft incentive wording + NDA options.
Anika: Target to finalize playbook by next Wednesday (5312346200). I'll take the rollup and send the public invite list. Thanks all :thumbsup:
